name: smwpatches-yump-reward-no-yump-penalty
title: Yump Reward / No-Yump Penalty
description:
This patch will give the player a reward for successfully yumping a Palace Switch. You can choose to give the player lives, coins, or give Mario a new powerup state. It also modifies the Palace message routine to not show the message until coins are finished adding up.

Conversely, you can also punish the player for failing a Yump. You can take away a few coins, make Mario small, outright give the player a game over for failing a Yump, and everything in-between.
